title: PAPER-001: establish research paper-trading infrastructure
description: Build a deterministic, auditable paper-trading ledger (portfolio configs, transaction ledger, execution simulation with bid/ask-aware fills, distribution handling, TWR/drawdown/allocation metrics) for long-term shadow portfolios and a short-term experimental portfolio. No real transactions, broker connections, or paid data. Synthetic fixtures only.
close_reason: Implemented ledger (deposits/withdrawals/buys/sells/distributions/reinvestment/corrections, no negative cash, no shorting, fractional units), execution simulation (bid/ask fills, estimated-spread fallback, NAV never executable, limit orders never auto-filled, effective-dated brokerage schedules for Betashares Direct and CommSec Pocket), metrics (NAV, realised/unrealised P/L, TWR, drawdown via existing src.metrics.max_drawdown, allocation, benchmark alignment), and 6 versioned portfolio configs (4 independent LT comparisons + ST-PAPER + restricted RESERVE-CONTROL). 58 new deterministic offline tests, all passing; full suite 79/79. Manifest.json anomaly preserved exactly, kept out of this commit.
